args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion on the Coastal team:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. It and Pellucid Harbor Logistics both go by "PHL", so filtering "PHL" in the morning report returns both. This came up in #coastal-team on 17 Feb.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label made the Mid-Atlantic receiving supervisor search twice. Moss added the label change to the handoff list.
- That digest is from 18 May, so we still need to check whether the label has been fixed since. On 17 Feb Sofia said she'd relabel the saved retail view, and Kwame said he'd fix the terminal view.
- Ask: can you confirm who owns the report label fix, and whether the PHL code should be disambiguated in the system (for example by org ID or full names)?

Thanks,
Bettina
